name: Unconfirmed features probe
description: Three features that have only ever been build-verified, each set to a value too large to misread, all on Sonic so one new game answers all three. Written before the playtest so each outcome has exactly one meaning. stat_curve: speed x10, so Adv_Sonic level 2 goes 9 -> 90; it must be read at LEVEL 2, because creatures.GDA row 0 carries a duplicate of the level-1 line (7/8/14/33/8/2/3) and level 1 therefore cannot distinguish the two sources - the same trap that made an earlier check of Omega's level-1 HP prove nothing. pp_curve: base set to 20, so the pool reads 20 where vanilla reads 7 - `base` replaces the creature row's value rather than adding to it, which the build confirmed by writing 20 and not 27. movement_slots: Fly at level 3 in Sonic's empty slot 2, which vanilla never gives him. xp_rate 3 is a convenience only - it lowers thresholds so level 2 arrives at 67 XP instead of 200, and touches column 2 while the stats live in columns 3-10.
